skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This is a local Chinese CIT tax-adjustment table checker whose scripts match its stated purpose and do not show network, persistence, credential, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill requests Read and Bash so the user can run the bundled Node script on an input file; this is proportionate, but users should expect to provide tax-table content locally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of a SKILL.md, one Node runner, one local engine module, and a sample JSON file; no external dependencies or install-time execution are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions clearly describe the free-version limits, withheld checks, insufficient-input behavior, and local execution model.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential/session access, background execution, tool wrapping, file mutation, or network use was found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is coherently focused on checking Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment tables for arithmetic, totals, duplicate rows, blanks, and negative adjustment amounts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you need a Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment table checker. It runs locally and appears limited to deterministic table checks, but it is not a full tax-compliance review and explicitly omits several tax-limit and eligibility checks.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The scanner reported incomplete inspection of the referenced runner, but the referenced scripts/run.mjs file and engine file are present and were fully inspected here; the reference is ordinary usage documentation.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language strings and Chinese table headers fit the skill's explicitly Chinese CIT tax-adjustment purpose rather than indicating hidden behavior.
[SDI-4] unexpected: One runner comment mentions generic pasted document text, while the actual help text and engine behavior require a tax-adjustment table; this is a minor documentation mismatch, not a security concern.
